ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( ISCHANGED(OwnerId),
ISPICKVAL(HealthAuthority__c, "Fraser Health - FH"),
$Profile.Name <> "System Administrator",
OR( AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Owner:Queue.DeveloperName)), NOT(CONTAINS(Owner:Queue.DeveloperName, "Fraser")) ),
AND( ISBLANK(Owner:Queue.DeveloperName), NOT(CONTAINS(Owner:User.Username, "fraser")) ) ) )
